body:
Reported on 1.14.0: in the add-expense dialog the paid-by / for rows are broken —
the checkbox takes ~70% of the row and the name and amount are crushed to the right.

Cause: the global `input, select, textarea` rule in web/src/index.css gives every
input `width: 100%` plus text-field padding (added so text fields shrink inside
flex rows). Checkboxes and radios are inputs too, so inside a flex row they claim
the free space. The expense dialog's share rows are the visible case; the list-type
radios on the overview's new-list form have the same shape and the same problem.

Fix at the root: exempt checkbox and radio from the text-field sizing.
title: web: checkboxes and radios inherit the text-field width, crushing their rows
